name: Scarlet Hunt
source:
In a land conquered by vampires, the last bastion of humanity remains. However, the continued independence of the kingdom came at a price - a bloody one. Each year, selected human slaves are forced to participate in a gruesome hunt for a chance to earn back their lives.

You take on a role of a young slave in a mining colony of the human kingdom. Years of brutal labor and oppression have burnt the mark of resentment deep into your heart. Suddenly, an opportunity arises - some say a curse, some say a blessing. Most say a death sentence. You won't change the world, but perhaps you can challenge your fate. Will you trust no one but yourself or will your feelings lead you astray? Will you live to see the light or will you give into the dark?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3541320/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在吸血鬼征服的大地上，人類最後的堡壘依然屹立。然而，這個王國要維持獨立，就得付出血淋淋的代價。每一年，都有被選中的人類奴隸被迫投入一場殘酷的狩獵，爭取贖回自己性命的機會。

你將扮演人類王國採礦殖民地裡的一名年輕奴隸。多年的殘酷勞役和壓迫，已將怨恨烙進你心底。突然，一個機會出現了——有人說是詛咒，有人說是賜福。多數人說，那是一紙死刑判決。你改變不了世界，但或許能挑戰自己的命運。你會只相信自己，還是會讓感情把你帶上歧途？你能活著看見光明，還是會向黑暗屈服？

［摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3541320/]Steam[/url]］
